plugins.name: roast
plugins.description: Pressure-test a business idea before you build it. Convenes a 5-angle adversarial panel â The Critic (what kills this?), The Champion (the 10x upside?), The Analyst (does the logic hold?), The Investigator (what does the market say?), The Customer (would I actually pay?) â fired in parallel as independent reviewers, then a Judge synthesizes one GO / RESHAPE / KILL verdict with explicit confidence and the cheapest 48-hour test to de-risk it. Never averages the scores: a weighted synthesizer with demand/fatal-flaw/logic veto gates produces the call, backed by deterministic stdlib tools.

The output is a single copy-paste prompt, never the build itself.

Fills the periodic-review gap from audit/productivity-2026-07.

plugins.name: deep-work
